newsitem.title: KENYA: Elephant tramples U.S. photographer Peter Beard.
newsitem.headline: Elephant tramples U.S. photographer Peter Beard.

text.p: World famous photographer Peter Beard suffered a broken pelvis and bites when he was trampled on by an elephant in a Nairobi wildlife park, hospital staff said late on Monday.

"He has left the operating theatre now and is in stable condition. He has a fractured pelvis and teethmarks on a thigh where the elephant bit him. But the bites did not reach the bone," a nursing sister told Reuters at Nairobi hospital.

The 58-year-old American was evacuated to Nairobi by the "flying doctor" service of the African Medical Research Foundation after the attack at Keekorok in Masai Mara national park near the Tanzanian border.
The hospital sister added it would be a while before Beard walked again and he would be in the hospital for some time.
Beard was out on safari with a Kenyan family, friends said.
Beard, who often visits Kenya, helped discover Somali-born model Iman and was married to the American model Cheryl Tiegs.
